mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary monetary tightening cycle, which increases equity discount rates and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 900 thousand units signals weak demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate monetary easing.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 900.0, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A positive trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is rising, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 100.0), the decline in industrial production signals reduced economic activity, which generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.
